source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 18ης Μαΐου — «Άγιος Ιουλιανός ο Μάρτυρας»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 18 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and its body is one sentence. **He is none of the corpus's fourteen Julians** — of Antinoopolis, Emesa, Kandavla, Samosata, Tarsus, the Euphrates, the Brazen Gate, the deacon of Aegina, the presbyter of Ancyra, the companions of Caesarius, Modestus and Pamphilus, the martyr of 2 September — which the namesweep flagged and which were read; none of them is kept on 18 May and none is dragged through a bramble. **The display name carries the day** because the page gives him no epithet, no country and no century. **No year at all, so no `dates` object.** **The alternative form is recorded and not stored**: the page says «Ο Άγιος Ιουλιανός (ή Ιούλιος)», Julian or Julius. No hymn is printed.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue on pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (30 September 2026).
